records.text: Owens said Roy Edgar McCoy ran psychological operations for naval intelligence to shape public perception.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Rob McCoy's father, Roy Edgar McCoy, ran psychological operations for naval intelligence to shape public perception.

verification.notes: Government and naval-history records support Roy Edgar McCoy's U.S. Navy service and identify him as commanding officer of USS Harry E. Hubbard. A live search did not locate a reliable primary or authoritative record confirming that he ran psychological operations for naval intelligence or that his work had the stated public-perception purpose. Repetitions found on social and video-summary pages trace back to the same unsupported assertion. The missing evidence is not treated as proof that the claim is false.
